name: DRAFT - NOT APPROVED - EXPERIMENTAL - XAUUSD provider S_TP4 M0 E2 1pct
description: Aggressive experimental ALTERNATE from the 2026-10-21 signal-provider research: single exit at TP4, no break-even, original stop, 1.0% risk. Stays within DEFAULT safety limits, including a 0.5 spread gate that the research did not test. UNAPPROVED research draft with NO demonstrated positive expectancy (OOS E2 mean +0.21R, 95% CI spans zero). Must not be activated without owner review and explicit authorization. Demo or paper use only. See recommendations.audit_warning: edit-timing audit found no edge on text-stable signals.

source.author: Claude research run (Haiku 5.5 xhigh subagents, coordinated)
source.notes: Research variant S_TP4|M0 under entry model E2 (project pending_at_range). Simulated on Dukascopy XAUUSD ticks, MID cost scenario, clean signals. Broker symbol and account specs unverified.

recommendations.not_executed: Recommendations are informational and never executed.

research_basis.variant: S_TP4|M0: 100% close at TP4, original SL (M0), no break-even
research_basis.result_OOS_E2: n=68, mean +0.21R, 95% CI [-0.47, +0.99], PF 1.24, closed max DD 22.6R, block-bootstrap p95 DD 45.5R, drop-top-5 mean -0.47R

recommendations.sizing_note: 1.0% risk is the default safety per-trade ceiling, and the default money cap (50 USD) binds above 5,000 USD equity. Research B3 gives a bootstrap p99 max DD of 24.3% at 5,000 USD for the 1% policy, on strict-entry trades (n=67), not on the E2 set.
recommendations.approximation: The research applied no spread gate (as far as the files read show), so a 0.5 gate is a new filter that the research results do not cover. Median spread at signal message times is 0.63 USD (SIGNAL_DATA_AUDIT.md), so this gate would refuse most signals. The OOS result therefore does not describe this profile's trade set. The 0.5 value is chosen only so the profile stays within default safety.
known_gaps: Same unresolved items as the conservative draft: broker symbol placeholder, unverified account and contract specs, untested edits, undefined MID cost, and the concurrency skip (max_concurrent_positions 1).
The 0.5 spread gate is the main reason this alternate differs from the research variant. It is set only to stay within default safety.
activation_blockers: Set symbols[0].broker_symbol to the exact Market Watch name.
Verify equity, leverage and contract specs. The 1% policy needs the owner's accepted drawdown tolerance (research p99 DD 24.3% at 5,000 USD).
Owner review and explicit authorization to approve and activate.
recommendations.forward_test_advice: Demo or paper only, with owner authorization. Highest variance of the four drafts. Its OOS drawdown (closed 22.6R, block p95 45.5R) is the deepest of the set. Not recommended as a first forward test.
recommendations.audit_warning: AUDIT WARNING (independent audit, exploratory, 2026-10): the positive OOS mean of this research family comes entirely from signals whose text was edited MORE than 5 minutes after posting (about 25% of signals; 80% of them already had TP1 touched before the edit). Among signals whose text was stable within 5 minutes (about 75%), modeled mean R is NEGATIVE for every tested exit (MID costs, E2: 100% TP1 -0.31R n=283; S_TP4|M0 -0.22R n=225; S_TP4|M5 -0.25R n=225). Original pre-edit levels are unrecoverable, so late edits may embed hindsight. Treat this profile as having NO demonstrated edge; it exists only as a documented, fail-closed research artifact. UPDATE 2026-10-24: a second out-of-sample test (58 signals, 2026-09-24..2026-10-22) gave -0.66R for this exact candidate (E2, MID costs, n=53, CI [-0.79,-0.52]); the earlier +0.20R did not replicate. Use only for an operations test on the demo account, with no profit expectation. See OOS2_AND_LIVE_CROSSCHECK.md.
